title: PROBAHO CRM Solutions
short_summary: A free desktop business system for retail showrooms and distributors that keeps billing and inventory records working when the internet drops. Built with local SQLite WebAssembly storage, automatic update checking, and courier delivery management.
how_it_was_made: Built with AI tools. I designed the product, defined the features, tested and released it.
features: Keeps billing and inventory working when the internet is down
Records who created and last edited each record
Built in courier profiles for Pathao, Steadfast, RedX, Paperfly, Sundarban and eCourier
Local backup export with single file database persistence

title: Portfolio Optimization and Efficient Frontier Simulation
course: FIN423: Securities Analysis and Portfolio Management
short_summary: Evaluated risk, return and covariance relationships across four Dhaka Stock Exchange equities over 250 trading days. Simulated 34 portfolio weight combinations to construct the Markowitz efficient frontier and identify the optimal Sharpe ratio allocation.
my_role: Lead analyst for Grameenphone stock valuation, covariance matrix formulation, and 34 portfolio efficient frontier simulation.

title: Equity Research and Valuation Modeling of Square Pharmaceuticals Ltd
short_summary: Prepared an institutional equity research report on Square Pharmaceuticals Ltd. Built a valuation model combining free cash flow to firm, dividend discount models, and relative peer multiples alongside five year pro forma projections.
my_role: Corporate governance structure, shareholding breakdown, board risk assessment, and long term revenue growth drivers.

title: Valuation Analysis and Industry Research of Bangladesh Pharmaceuticals
short_summary: Analysed company fundamentals, industry growth trends, and ten year stock return distributions across Square Pharma, Beximco, Renata, and Ibn Sina. Applied two stage dividend discount models and cash flow methods to compare intrinsic values against market prices.
my_role: Valuation models, return distribution statistics, and pharmaceutical industry competitive analysis.
